items.label: BACK SUPPORT FOR MAXIMUM COMFORT
items.value: This heavy-duty camping chair includes adjustable lumbar support, upholstered cushions, and hard armrests, all designed to help you relax more. Its ergonomic design conforms to the natural curvature of your spine, providing you with excellent support and comfort for long hours of sitting.

items.label: SPACIOUS SEAT
items.value: With a comfortable width of 22 inches and a depth of 17.5 inches, our chairs offer plenty of room to stretch out and relax. The back of the chair is 27.5 inches high and the entire product measures 41 inches. Sturdy and lightweight, weighing 13.5 lbs.

items.label: HEAVY DUTY SUPPORT 450 LBS
items.value: Composed of a sturdy steel frame, this heavy duty folding chair is built to withstand up to 450 pounds for durability. Each chair is professionally pressure tested for strength and durability for quality you can trust.

items.label: MULTIFUNCTIONAL SIDE POCKETS
items.value: This heavy-duty lawn chair features multifunctional pockets and a large cup holder, so you can easily store 20 oz of beverages, snacks, and your cell phone without worrying about finding a place to put them.

items.label: IDEAL FOR OUTDOOR ENTERTAINMENT
items.value: Whether you're camping, fishing, attending a sporting event, or just spending time in the backyard.Each product is meticulously crafted with care and supported by our dedication to ensuring customer contentment. Should any concerns arise, our assistance is readily available.

items.value: Adjustable Lumbar, Arm Rest, Cup Holders, Side Pocket
